kai: Quick q — we have encrypted+signed safetensors bundles with mixed-quant shards. Current verify step blocks warmup and spikes cold-start latency. Any preferred approach?

taylor: Agree this is a pain. My vote: header-first latch so we can start warmup ASAP, then do full crypto/byte-verify in background.

devon: Header-first how? if we only verify manifest but not shard payloads, attacker could flip a shard in-flight. Need mitigation.

ana: Two-phase verify is what we used elsewhere: 1) verify top-level manifest signature + shard descriptors (sizes/checksums) 2) async verify payloads. For warmup, allow ephemeral reads but forbid attaching to KV cache until payloads VERIFIED.

sam: State machine idea: UNTRUSTED_EPHEMERAL -> VERIFIED -> PROMOTED. Ephemeral reads allowed for non-critical ops; promotion requires full verify. TTL + fallback if verify fails. :thinking_face: 

kai: Proto sketch: loader reads manifest, validates manifest sig, schedules parallel decrypt+verify for shards. For warmup, accept shard into UNTRUSTED_EPHEMERAL with metadata flag no-kv-attach. That lets token generation start while full verify runs. In our sims that shaved ~40-50% off p95 for small prompts.

ml-bot: perf note: prototype run on toy-v1 mixed-quant reduced p95 cold-start from 320ms -> 190ms, background IO +12%.

devon: My worry: some models place critical parameters (LN/bias) across shards. If an ephemeral shard is used before verified you can get subtly wrong outputs. We should restrict ephemeral reads for layers flagged CRITICAL.

taylor: We can add manifest metadata per-layer or per-shard: CRITICAL vs NONCRITICAL. Default conservative = mark all layer groups CRITICAL until model owner annotates. That requires minor manifest schema bump.

ana: Also need robust eviction behavior: verifier may be mid-IO when shard gets evicted. Use chunked verification and resume tokens so verifier can resume if shard is paged back. Keep verifier idempotent.

sam: Security checklist: add KMS/audit events for manifest-verify failures and for deferred-verify promotions. Also ensure we don't leak decryption keys to lower-priv pools during ephemeral reads.

kai: Action items: I'll write RFC follow-up covering state machine, manifest flags, and loader API changes. Ana will prototype loader flow: header-first warmup + no-kv-attach semantics + promotion. Sam coordinate security review. Taylor add perf harness. ETA EOW?

taylor: +1. Please include a small CLI to simulate mixed-quant bundles and manifest-critical toggles.

devon: I'll draft the per-shard resume protocol for chunked verify and eviction.

kai: I'll post a first draft tomorrow morning. Thanks all.
